outcome: Maternal complications (severe infections, vital organ damage, respiratory problems, bone marrow suppression)
cohort: Pregnant women with homozygous Sickle Cell Disease who had given birth or were followed up at the gynaecology and obstetrics department of a university hospital in Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire.
finding: Sickle cell disease in pregnancy is associated with a significant occurrence of complications and an increased risk of maternal and fetal complications.
